title: Movement speed
text:
Movement speed (often referred to as MS) is a stat that determines the rate at which an entity can move. It is used to determine the player's walk/run speed, as well as the speed of a dodge roll. The base movement speed modifier of a player is treated as 0% in the Miscellaneous section of the Character screen, which can be interpreted as 100% of base movement speed.


== Mechanics ==


=== Armour movement penalties ===

To calculate movement speed, first the movement speed penalty must be considered. Body armours and shields have an inherent movement speed penalty that applies to base movement speed (100% by default) when equipped according to the following:

Pure evasion shields (bucklers) and foci do not have movement speed penalties.
Other modifiers to movement speed apply to the movement speed value after penalties. For example, boots with 20% increased Movement Speed on a character wearing an energy shield body armour will have a movement speed of:

    \color [rgb]{0.6392156862745098,0.5529411764705883,0.42745098039215684}116.4
  

So the player will have 116.4% of base movement speed, or +16.4% Movement speed modifier.


=== Movement speed penalty ===
Most skills allow movement during the skill animation, with a 70% less movement speed penalty (50% less for command skills). Effects which decrease movement speed penalty will allow you to move faster while using these skills.


== Related effects ==


=== Buffs ===
Onslaught grants 10% increased Movement Speed.
Tailwind grants 1% increased Movement Speed per stack.


=== Debuffs ===
Slows reduce movement speed by varying amounts.


=== Other ===
Sprinting increases the player character's movement speed by 50%.
While in Werewolf form, moving for 1 second or sprinting makes your character run on all four legs, grants 30% increased Movement Speed except while sprinting. Using a skill will cause you to stand on two legs.
